novelty_basis: Historian derivation (reviews/historian_C01_C02.md, section 2 (C)): identities (P) H = G_y + x^(k-|y|) G_z and (E) H(1 - qx) + x^k G_z = 1 read off Gray-Steinberg 2022 Thm 6.6 and Props 8.3, 8.5 (G_w = growth series of the left ideal M[w]); for y = z they give the formula. No published statement of the growth formula found.
statement:
If u != v of length k share exactly one common border z (neither border set containing the other), the class
counts have generating function c/(x^k + (1 - q x) c) with c = 1 + x^(k - |z|).
title: Common-border formula with exactly one common border (derivation sketch from Gray-Steinberg 2022)
